tool_bounds_keyboard_help: Use arrow keys to move or resize by one source pixel; hold Shift for ten pixels.

meta_tool_title: Rusticker: make WhatsApp stickers in your browser
meta_tool_description: Cut a whole sticker sheet into a WhatsApp-ready pack. Everything happens in your browser; your images are never uploaded.
meta_how_to_use_description: Step by step: prepare your image, cut out the stickers, and import the pack into WhatsApp.
meta_about_description: Rusticker processes your images on your own device. Nothing is uploaded, there is no account or tracking, and the code is open source.
page_how_to_use_intro: In a few steps, a single image with many stickers becomes a pack ready for WhatsApp.
page_how_to_use_step_prepare: Prepare an image with all your stickers on a background of one uniform color, such as chroma-key green, with a little space between them.
page_how_to_use_step_open: Open Rusticker and add the image: drag the file in, choose it from your device, or paste it with Ctrl+V.
page_how_to_use_step_adjust: Check the detected stickers. If needed, pick the background color with the eyedropper and adjust the tolerance.
page_how_to_use_step_download: Remove any stickers you do not want, choose the pack icon, and download the .zip file.
page_how_to_use_step_import: On your phone, open the .zip with a sticker-pack importer app and add the pack to WhatsApp.
page_how_to_use_import_note: Each WhatsApp pack needs 3 to 30 stickers. If you have more than 30, Rusticker splits them into several packs.
page_about_intro: Rusticker cuts a whole sticker sheet into a WhatsApp-ready pack, right in your browser.
page_about_privacy_body: All image processing happens locally, on your device. Your images are never uploaded to any server.
page_about_no_account_body: There is no account, no sign-up, and no tracking. The site only remembers the language you choose, and only in your browser.
page_about_open_source_body: Rusticker is an open-source project, released under the MIT license.
design_intro: Development-only page: every design-system component and variant, in the light and dark themes.
design_overlays_note: Dialogs, menus, tooltips and toasts use the page theme. Switch it here:

design_sample_muted: Secondary text for hints and descriptions.
design_sample_icon_note: Icon-only buttons need an accessible name from the caller.
design_sample_dialog_body: Focus stays inside the dialog until it is closed.

meta_history_description: Review local summaries of images processed with Rusticker.
meta_upscaler_description: Enlarge one image locally with conventional browser resampling. Your image is never uploaded.
upscaler_description: Enlarge one static image in your browser, then save the result as a PNG.
upscaler_method_note: Uses conventional browser resampling. Enlarging does not create new image detail.
upscaler_onnx_disclosure: Runs a model you select locally in this browser using CPU/WASM. The model and image are not uploaded. Models must accept dynamic NCHW RGB float32 input and return 4× output. Processing can be slow and use substantial memory; quality measurements are advisory.
upscaler_onnx_scale_note: The selected model produces a fixed 4× result. The original alpha channel is resized separately.
upscaler_limits: Maximum side: {side} pixels. Maximum image size: {pixels} pixels.
upscaler_output_limit_error: This scale would exceed the supported output dimensions. Choose a smaller scale.
upscaler_empty_state: Choose a PNG, JPEG, or static WebP image to begin.
upscaler_error_unsupported: This image format is not supported. Choose a PNG, JPEG, or static WebP image.
upscaler_error_malformed: This image appears to be incomplete or invalid. Choose another file.
upscaler_error_animated: Animated images are not supported yet. Choose a static image.
upscaler_error_limits: This image or requested result exceeds the supported dimensions or pixel limit.
upscaler_error_environment: This browser does not support local image upscaling.
upscaler_error_decode: The image could not be decoded. The original selection is still available.
upscaler_error_encode: The PNG result could not be created. The original selection is still available.
upscaler_error_model: This model is not compatible. Choose a dynamic RGB float32 NCHW model with a 4× output.
upscaler_error_inference: The model could not process this image. The original selection is still available; try another model or use conventional resize.
upscaler_error_memory: The browser could not allocate enough memory for this result. Try a smaller image or conventional resize.
upscaler_error_generic: Upscaling failed. The original selection is still available; try again.
history_privacy_explanation: If enabled, Rusticker saves the completion date, image dimensions, background color, tolerance, and sticker count on this device. It may also save a private SHA-256 fingerprint to recognize the exact same file. Fingerprints are never shown or sent anywhere. History keeps at most 50 runs for up to 90 days; your browser can remove it sooner.
history_no_images_retained: Source images, file names, sticker pixels, and exported packs are never saved. History is best-effort browser storage and may be removed by your browser.
history_reselect_notice: History entries are summaries only. To process or export again, select the original image on the tool page.
history_disable_prompt: New runs will no longer be saved. Choose whether to keep or delete the summaries already stored on this device.
history_storage_unavailable: Browser storage is unavailable. Processing and export still work, but history cannot be read or saved.
history_save_unavailable: This run could not be added to history. Your processing result is still available.
history_empty: No processing runs have been saved yet.
history_duplicate_notice: This exact file had been processed before.
history_clear_confirm_body: This permanently deletes all Rusticker history summaries and local fingerprints from this browser.
export_error_webp_unsupported: This browser can't create WEBP stickers. Try Chrome, Edge, or Firefox.
export_error_failed: Couldn't create the pack. Please try again.
footer_processing_local: All image processing stays in your browser.
webmcp_open_picker_description: Open the image picker so the person can choose an image. Does not read or provide image contents.
webmcp_status_description: Return only the current coarse workflow state: empty, image loaded, reviewing results, or ready to export.
telegram_export_instructions: This ZIP contains image files only; it is not a Telegram sticker set. Extract the files, then add them in Telegram's sticker editor or use @Stickers to create a set.
telegram_export_success: Prepared {count} static sticker files for Telegram.
telegram_export_webp_unsupported: This browser can't create transparent WEBP files. Choose PNG or try another browser.
telegram_export_failed: Couldn't prepare the Telegram sticker files. Please try again.
static_export_jpeg_background_required: Choose a background color before exporting JPEG files.
static_export_failed: Couldn't prepare the static sticker files. Please try again.
pdf_sheet_edit_instructions: Select a sticker, drag it in the preview, or use the move and resize controls. On a focused preview, use arrow keys to move and + or − to resize.
pdf_sheet_empty: Detect stickers to preview a printable sheet.
pdf_sheet_export_unsupported: This browser cannot prepare PDF sheets. Try another browser.
pdf_sheet_export_failed: Could not prepare the PDF sheets. Please try again.
